import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/test_0.csv"

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_df = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)

# Transformation:
# The target table Target1_34 has schema ['V_GENE'].
# Source0 has schema ['J_CALL'].
# The target examples show that V_GENE values correspond exactly to J_CALL values.
# Therefore, the transformation is a simple renaming of the column J_CALL to V_GENE.

target_df = source0_df.rename(columns={"J_CALL": "V_GENE"})

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_34/target_multisource_cot.csv"
target_df.to_csv(output_path)
